sentences.text: Counsel for Petitioner :- Shami Ullah Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Atul Kumar Kushwaha Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

This habeas corpus writ petition has been filed on behalf of Shabnam Parveen (corpus) through her husband petitioner no. 2 namely Mohd. Mustakeem with the allegation that the corpus has been illegally detained by respondent no. 4 who is father of corpus.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no. 4 has raised preliminary objection that the present habeas corpus writ petition has been filed by petitioner no. 2 on behalf of corpus petitioner no. 1 by concealing material facts.
It is submitted that there is matrimonial dispute between the husband petitioner no. 2 and wife petitioner no. 1 (corpus).

entities.text: Shabnam Parveen And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 information report has been lodged by petitioner no. 1 against her husband petitioner no. 2 and his other family members which was registered as Case Crime No. 0306 of 2022, under Sections 498A,
323, 315 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act.
Copy of first information report has been produced by learned counsel for the respondent no. 4 is taken on record.
In the said case the Investigating Officer after due investigation has submitted charge sheet against petitioner no. 2 and his other family members.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that the corpus namely Shabnam Parveen is tortured by her husband and other family members and she voluntarily lives with her father respondent no. 4 and there is no illegal detention of corpus.

In view of above, since the corpus has voluntarily left the company of her husband and has also lodged a first information report against him and his other family members, the corpus could not be said to be in illegal confinement of her father respondent no. 4 namely Shahzad and the present habeas corpus writ petition is liable to be dismissed.
The habeas corpus writ petition is dismissed, accordingly.
